summary: Warriors are armoured melee fighters who build Rage by fighting and taking damage. They switch between Battle, Defensive and Berserker Stance to attack, tank or flank, and wear plate armour.
talent_levels_note: A talent ability can be taken once you can reach its row: the first talent point comes at level 10 and each row needs 5 more points, so row N opens at level 10 + 5 × (N − 1). Talent rows are from wowforevertalent.com; the Forever tooltips of Piercing Howl (20), Sweeping Strikes (30), Concussion Blow (30) and Mortal Strike, Bloodthirst and Shield Slam (40) show the same levels.

abilities.name: Battle Stance
abilities.text: A balanced combat stance.
abilities.summary: A balanced combat stance.

abilities.note: Ranks at levels 4, 26 and 46. Requires Battle Stance (usable in Defensive Stance with the Protection talent Vanguard).
abilities.name: Charge
abilities.text: Charge an enemy, generate 9 Rage, and Stun it for 1 sec. Cannot be used in combat.
abilities.summary: Charge an enemy, generate 9 Rage, and Stun it for 1 sec.

abilities.name: Hamstring
abilities.text: Maims the enemy, causing 5 damage and slowing the enemy's movement by 40% for 15 sec.
abilities.summary: Maims the enemy, causing 5 damage and slowing the enemy's movement by 40% for 15 sec.

abilities.name: Heroic Strike
abilities.text: A strong attack that increases melee damage by 11 and causes a high amount of threat.
abilities.summary: A strong attack that increases melee damage by 11 and causes a high amount of threat.

abilities.name: Mocking Blow
abilities.text: A mocking attack that causes 22 damage, a moderate amount of threat and forces the target to focus attacks on you for 6 sec.
abilities.summary: A mocking attack that causes 22 damage, a moderate amount of threat and forces the target to focus attacks on you for 6 sec.

abilities.name: Overpower

abilities.summary: Instantly overpower the enemy, causing weapon damage plus 5.

abilities.summary: Wounds the target causing them to bleed for 15 damage over 9 sec.

abilities.summary: Instantly counterattack any enemy that strikes you in melee for 15 sec.

abilities.summary: Blasts nearby enemies, increasing the time between their attacks by 20% for 10 sec and doing 10 damage to them.

abilities.note: New in Forever: usable within 20 sec of killing an enemy that gives experience or honour; heals you for 10% of your maximum health.
abilities.name: Victory Rush
abilities.text: Instantly attack the target causing (1 + Attack Power * 15 / 100) damage and healing you for 10% of your maximum health. Only useable within 20 sec after you kill a non-trivial enemy.
abilities.summary: Instantly attack the target causing (1 + Attack Power * 15 / 100) damage and healing you for 10% of your maximum health.

abilities.note: New in Forever: an Arms talent.
abilities.name: Spearing Strike
abilities.text: A brutal attack that deals 75% weapon damage. Deals an additional 75% weapon damage against Giants, Dragonkin, and mounted targets. Mounted targets are dismounted.
abilities.summary: A brutal attack that deals 75% weapon damage.

abilities.name: Sweeping Strikes
abilities.text: Your next 5 melee attacks strike an additional nearby opponent.
abilities.summary: Your next 5 melee attacks strike an additional nearby opponent.

abilities.name: Mortal Strike

abilities.summary: A vicious strike that deals weapon damage plus 85 and wounds the target, reducing the effectiveness of any healing by 50% for 10 sec.

abilities.summary: The warrior shouts, increasing the melee attack power of all party or raid members within 20 yards by 12.

abilities.summary: The warrior enters a berserker rage, becoming immune to Fear and Incapacitate effects and generating extra rage when taking damage.

abilities.summary: An aggressive stance.

abilities.summary: Forces all nearby enemies within 10 yards to focus attacks on you for 6 sec.

abilities.summary: A sweeping attack that does your weapon damage plus 5 to the target and a second nearby enemy.

abilities.name: Demoralizing Shout

abilities.summary: Reduces the melee attack power of all enemies within 10 yards by 63 for 45 sec.

abilities.name: Execute

abilities.summary: Attempt to finish off a wounded foe, causing 125 damage and converting each extra point of rage into 3 additional damage.

abilities.summary: Charge an enemy, causing 25 damage and stunning it for 3 sec.

abilities.summary: Pummel the target for 20 damage.

abilities.summary: In a whirlwind of steel you attack up to 4 enemies within 8 yards, causing weapon damage from both melee weapons to each enemy.

abilities.summary: Slams the opponent, causing weapon damage plus 16.

abilities.summary: Causes all enemies within 10 yds to be Dazed, reducing movement speed by 50% for 6 sec.

abilities.summary: Your next 4 melee attacks generate 5 additional Rage.

abilities.summary: When activated, increases your Physical damage done by 20% and makes you immune to Fear effects, but increases all damage you take by 5%.

abilities.summary: Instantly attack the target causing damage equal to 45% of your Attack Power plus 30 and increasing your movement speed by 10% for 10 sec.

abilities.summary: Disarm the enemy's weapon for 10 sec.

abilities.text: Instantly counterattack an enemy for [20.3077 + (0 * Attack Power)] to [23.6923 + (0 * Attack Power)] damage and a high amount of threat. Revenge must follow a block, dodge or parry.
abilities.summary: Instantly counterattack an enemy for [20.3077 + (0 * Attack Power)] to [23.6923 + (0 * Attack Power)] damage and a high amount of threat.

abilities.summary: Bashes the target with your shield for 6 damage.

abilities.summary: Increases chance to block by 75% for 7 sec, but will only block 2 attacks.

abilities.summary: Reduces the damage taken from all attacks by 60% for 12 sec.

abilities.summary: Stuns the target for 5 sec.

changes: New spells: Victory Rush (level 20, Arms), plus the talent abilities Spearing Strike (Arms) and Reckless Swings (Fury).
Slam gets a new Rank 1 at level 20 and a fifth rank at 54; Classic's ranks arrive at 30, 38, 46 and 54.
Tactical Mastery is now a trained passive at level 14 instead of a talent (Improved Tactical Mastery stays a talent).
Berserker Rage is learned at level 30 with Berserker Stance.
Charge is available in Defensive Stance with the new Protection talent Vanguard.
Thunder Clap can be used in Battle and Defensive Stance.
New passive talents: Bloodthrill, Weaponmaster (Arms), Lingering Rage, Furious Precision, Gore Drinker, Improved Whirlwind (Fury), Master of Defense, Vanguard, Focused Rage (Protection).
conflicts: wowforevertalent.com lists Charge as 'Rank 3' but its text mentions levels 4, 26 and 46; conquestcapped.com agrees with those levels.
wowforevertalent.com lists Intercept and Bloodrage with different 'Changed' tags in its list and notes; only the spell data here is used.
wowforevertalent.com says Mortal Strike may remain in the spellbook but cannot be used without the talent; it is listed here as a talent ability only.
gaps: Every rank after the first and the level it is trained at (only Slam, Charge and Intercept ranks are noted from fan sites).
Passive talents (Bloodthrill, Weaponmaster, Lingering Rage, Gore Drinker and others); no new capstone passives were found, so passive_talents is empty.
Tactical Mastery (a trained passive, spell 1310185, level 14) and other passives are not listed as abilities.
Quest-learned warrior spells were not checked.
Thrown and ranged weapon skills (Throw, Shoot Bow/Crossbow/Gun) are left out as general skills.
